sections.title: AI Automation Applications for Denver Organizations
sections.description: Production automation solutions for Denver's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Aerospace Engineering Document Automation
paragraphs: For Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton), United Launch Alliance (Centennial), and the Space Corridor:

Engineering specification processing: AI extracting structured requirements, specifications, and test criteria from engineering documents for Lockheed's and ULA's supply chain and procurement teams — reducing the manual data extraction that program managers perform when processing supplier specifications and design documentation.

Supplier qualification document automation: AI processing supplier AS9100 certificates, first-article inspection reports, and qualification test data for aerospace supply chain qualification management.
Contract and purchase order processing: Automated extraction of scope, deliverables, and key terms from the complex procurement contracts in aerospace's specialized procurement environment.
Cost: $30,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | Self-hosted processing, AS9100

blocks.heading: Energy Regulatory Compliance Automation
paragraphs: For Xcel Energy (Denver HQ) and Colorado's utility and oil and gas community:

FERC and NERC compliance reporting: AI automating the compilation and formatting of Xcel Energy's mandatory FERC and NERC regulatory filings — reliability event reports, market power filings, and transmission planning documentation.

COGCC (Colorado Oil and Gas Conservation Commission) reporting: AI processing and formatting required oil and gas regulatory filings for Colorado's DJ Basin operators — well completion reports, environmental monitoring, and production reporting automation.
Environmental compliance: AI for Colorado DECCs environmental compliance reporting — emissions monitoring, spill reporting, and environmental impact documentation for Colorado's energy industry.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks | FERC, NERC, COGCC context

blocks.heading: Healthcare Revenue Cycle Automation
paragraphs: For UCHealth, Centura/Intermountain, and Denver's health systems:

Colorado payer prior authorization: AI assembling PA documentation for Colorado's major commercial payers (Anthem Colorado, Cigna Colorado, Aetna Colorado, UnitedHealth CO) and Colorado Medicaid (HCPF) for UCHealth's and Centura's high-volume PA workflows.

Revenue integrity and coding: AI for clinical documentation improvement and coding accuracy for Denver's health systems — identifying documentation gaps and coding optimization opportunities in UCHealth's large inpatient and outpatient billing operations.

Colorado AI Act-compliant automation: Healthcare automation that constitutes a high-risk automated decision system under Colorado's SB24-205 AI Act must include impact assessments — ClickMasters designs Denver healthcare automation with Colorado AI Act compliance.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | HIPAA + Colorado AI Act

blocks.heading: Colorado Government Document Automation
paragraphs: For Colorado's Office of Information Technology and state agencies:

Benefits application processing: AI extracting structured data from Colorado Medicaid (HCPF), unemployment insurance (CDLE), and state benefits applications — helping caseworkers process applications more efficiently without replacing eligibility determination.
Permit and licensing automation: AI for CDOT, DOR, and state licensing agencies' high-volume document processing.
State procurement automation: AI for OSPB (Office of State Planning and Budgeting) and state procurement documentation.
Cost: $20,000–$70,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks | Colorado state data governance

blocks.heading: Outdoor Industry Operations Automation
paragraphs: For REI (Kent WA HQ, major Colorado operations) and Vail Resorts (Broomfield CO HQ):
Rental equipment processing: AI for REI's large outdoor gear rental program — equipment inspection documentation, maintenance records, and rental agreement processing.

Ski resort operations documents: AI for Vail Resorts' large employee and operations documentation — seasonal employee onboarding, lift maintenance records, and snowmaking operations documentation processing.
Cost: $20,000–$65,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks
